question: In which of the following years PM-KISAN (Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi) was formally launched?
solution:
The correct answer is __**2019**__.

__
 
• **PM-KISAN (Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi)**__ is a central sector scheme under the Government of India that provides income support to farmers and their families.

 __
 
• ​Under this scheme, **the Center transfers Rs 6,000 per year, in three equal installments**, directly to the bank accounts of all landholder farmers, irrespective of the size of their landholdings.
 
• **It was launched in February 2019**__.
